description: Hierarchical navigation trail. Wraps existing <ol> markup HTML-first (canonical markup: inside <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">), or auto-generates from window.location.pathname. Emits BreadcrumbList JSON-LD for SEO.

attributes.name: data-from-pathname
attributes.description: When present, auto-generates the trail from window.location.pathname. Each path segment is URL-decoded and becomes a crumb (Title-Cased by default; override per segment via the .labels property). A leading Home crumb is always added.

attributes.name: data-current-label
attributes.description: Label for the final (current page) crumb when auto-generating. Takes precedence over .labels; if omitted, .labels or the Title-Cased last path segment is used.

attributes.name: data-separator
attributes.description: Separator glyph variant: 'chevron', 'arrow', 'dot', 'pipe'. Unset uses the theme's --sep-breadcrumb token (› by default). Drives the --_separator CSS var; separators are decorative (empty CSS alt text) and not announced.

attributes.name: data-collapsed
attributes.description: Hide middle crumbs, keeping the first crumb, the parent (second-to-last) and the current page. With four or more crumbs the component inserts an ellipsis <button aria-expanded> (accessible name 'Show full path') after the first crumb that reveals the hidden crumbs.

childAttributes.name: data-truncated
childAttributes.description: Apply to a crumb <li> to truncate its link/label with an ellipsis (max-inline-size 10rem). The full text is still read by screen readers.

structure.description: The trail; one <li> per crumb containing an <a> (ancestors) or <span> (current page). Generated in data-from-pathname mode.
Injected by data-collapsed: wraps the 'Show full path' <button aria-expanded>. Excluded from aria-current and JSON-LD.
Appended BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (unless data-jsonld="off"); item URLs are the anchors' resolved hrefs.

events.name: bread-crumb:toggle
events.description: Fired when the data-collapsed toggle button expands or collapses the trail

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Segment → label map for data-from-pathname mode. Keys may be a full pathname ('/docs/elements/'), a pathname without the trailing slash, or a single (decoded or raw) segment; '/' or 'home' relabels the Home crumb. Assigning re-renders the trail.
